name: HIPAA Security Rule
description: HIPAA Technical Safeguards (45 CFR §164.312) — required security controls for protected health information

controls.name: System access controls
controls.desc: SSH root login disabled, key auth enforced, no extra UID 0, no world-writable system files, password hashes and shadow file protected.

controls.name: Unique user identification
controls.desc: No duplicate UID 0 accounts, root login disabled — each user must authenticate individually.

controls.name: Session security
controls.desc: X11 forwarding disabled to prevent session hijacking over forwarded display connections; auto-login disabled on Windows.

controls.name: Audit controls
controls.desc: Audit daemon active, logon events recorded, time synchronized so events correlate across systems, failed logins surfaced for review.

controls.name: Data integrity controls
controls.desc: Mandatory access control active, ASLR on, SUID binaries audited, no world-writable files, anti-malware protection enabled.

controls.name: Authentication mechanisms
controls.desc: Public key authentication enabled, brute-force limited via MaxAuthTries / account lockout, password policies enforced.

controls.name: Transmission security
controls.desc: Strong TLS enforced, weak protocols and ciphers disabled, certificates valid, SMB signing required, BitLocker active for data at rest.

controls.name: Encryption standards
controls.desc: No weak TLS versions (SSLv3, TLSv1), no broken ciphers (RC4, DES, 3DES), legacy WDigest credential storage disabled.
